content: {"like":["Thriller action films with strong, realistic performances (e.g., Sicario, Black Mass).","Crime dramas that explore gritty, realistic character motivations (e.g., Creed).","Romantic dramas focusing on age-gap relationships and emotional depth (e.g., Carol).","British period dramas with simple, sweet storytelling and well-acted characters (e.g., Brooklyn).","Comedy‑dramas that balance humor with heartfelt, believable character interactions (e.g., The Lady in the Van)."],"dislike":["Action thrillers with unrealistic plot elements or poor writing (e.g., Sicario).","Films with poorly developed protagonists or unexplained odd behavior (e.g., Return to Sender).","Horror sequels with unconvincing motives and disjointed storytelling (e.g., Sinister 2).","Movies featuring graphic, sudden violence that feels gratuitous (e.g., Black Mass).","Films with excessive foul language or disjointed narrative pacing (e.g., The Night Before)."]}
